faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about GeoRank and how it helps your brand dominate AI search results.

items.question: What AI platforms do you track?
items.answer: We currently monitor ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, and more—always using the latest and most robust models available. We continuously add new platforms as they gain market share.

items.question: How often is data updated?
items.answer:
GeoRank works in two ways: keyword queries and recommendations are generated based on the training data of each AI model, giving you a baseline visibility picture. For deeper insights, our system performs a real-time deep research—analyzing your domains, keywords, and recommendations—to generate a comprehensive report on your brand's AI presence.

Frequency depends on your plan: Free updates monthly, First Movers and Starter weekly, Pro and Agency daily, and Enterprise as frequently as every hour.

items.question: What's a "GEO Score"?
items.answer: Your GEO Score (0-100) measures how often and how prominently AI mentions your brand for your tracked keywords. Higher is better.

items.question: Can I track competitors?
items.answer: Yes! Competitor tracking starts from the First Movers plan (1 competitor) and scales up: Starter tracks 3, Pro tracks 10, and Agency tracks up to 50. Enterprise plans have virtually unlimited competitor tracking. See exactly who AI recommends instead of you and why.

items.question: Can I try before subscribing?
items.answer: Yes! We offer a free plan so you can explore GeoRank with no commitment. When you're ready to upgrade, you can cancel anytime—no contracts, no cancellation fees.

items.question: Is there an API?
items.answer: API access is available from the Starter plan onwards. You can integrate GeoRank data into your existing dashboards, workflows, and custom tools.

items.question: Do you add new features and AI models over time?
items.answer:
Absolutely! GeoRank is an early-stage product with an ambitious medium-term roadmap. We update our AI models with every new generation released by each platform, ensuring you always get the most recent and capable models.

We're actively building: visibility breakdowns by model, region and audience, brand visibility scoring, source visibility metrics, citation tracking, suggested prompts, and much more. New features ship regularly—stay tuned.

postDetail.title: A Comprehensive Guide on Importing Customers
postDetail.description: Delivering a good user experience without compromising the authoring experience required us to rethink data onboarding.
postDetail.author: Savannah Nguyen
postDetail.content:
Why Customer Importing Matters

For any SaaS business, importing customer data is one of the most crucial and delicate onboarding steps. Done right, it feels invisible—users see their customers appear instantly, ready to go. Done poorly, it can erode trust in your product before the first session even ends.

At Metafi, we built a customer import framework that balances flexibility for developers with safety for operators. It’s the bridge between data chaos and a working CRM.

Data Sources: CSV, API, and Direct Sync

  • CSV Imports: Still the most common route. Easy for users but error-prone. We introduced schema detection and instant feedback to validate headers and data types before upload.
  • API Imports: Ideal for power users. APIs let larger clients run nightly syncs. We versioned endpoints, added safe retries, and built audit trails for every record.
  • Direct Sync: Integrations with tools like Salesforce or HubSpot use OAuth2 to ensure secure tokenized access. Data sync happens in near real-time with rollback on any validation failure.

Mapping and Validation

Every import requires a mapping layer. We designed a guided UI that auto-detects columns but lets users override or ignore fields. Behind the scenes, our validator checks:

  • Email and phone format
  • Duplicates and conflicts
  • Referential integrity (linked accounts or billing info)

If errors occur, users can download a detailed CSV error report.

Safe Retries and Rollbacks

Our import pipeline is idempotent. Each row carries a unique checksum. If a retry is triggered, we skip rows that already succeeded, and roll back only the failed subset.
That means no duplicate customers and no partial imports that silently break your CRM.

Compliance and Security

Customer data import isn’t just technical—it’s regulatory. GDPR and CCPA require clear data provenance. We store every import event with metadata (who, when, what source) and allow admins to delete datasets at any time.

Lessons Learned

  1. Transparency beats magic: Users prefer seeing progress and errors clearly.
  2. Asynchronous jobs need real-time feedback: a progress bar or webhook beats silent background tasks.
  3. Validation early saves engineering pain later.

With these principles, importing customers becomes not just a setup step—but a trust-building moment in your user journey.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how GeoRank ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and shares information when you use our AI search visibility monitoring platform and related services (the "Service").

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect the following types of information:

  • Account Information
    When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, company name, and billing details.
  • Usage Data
    We automatically collect data about how you interact with the Service, including pages visited, features used, and session duration.
  • Monitoring Data
    When you configure brand monitoring, we collect the brand names, keywords, and AI platform queries you set up. We also store the AI-generated responses and mention data we retrieve on your behalf.
  • Device & Log Data
    We collect IP addresses, browser type, operating system, and device identifiers for security and analytics purposes.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
• To provide, maintain, and improve the Service
  • To monitor your brand's visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini
  • To generate analytics reports, GEO Scores, and actionable recommendations
  • To process payments and manage subscriptions
  • To send transactional emails (reports, alerts, account notifications)
  • To detect and prevent fraud or abuse
  • To comply with legal obligations

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.content:
We do not sell your personal data. We may share your information with:

  • Service Providers — Third-party companies that help us operate the Service (hosting, payment processing, email delivery)
  • Analytics Partners — We use privacy-focused analytics (Umami) that do not use cookies or collect personally identifiable information
  • Legal Requirements — When required by law, regulation, or legal process

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. Monitoring data (AI responses, mention history) is retained for the duration of your subscription plus 30 days after cancellation. You may request deletion of your data at any time.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.content:
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your data
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Data portability (receive your data in a structured format)
  • Withdraw consent at any time

For users in Brazil, these rights are provided under the LGPD. For users in the EU/EEA, under the GDPR.

sections.heading: Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS), encryption at rest, and access controls. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.content: The Service is not directed to individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

privacy.contact: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: <email>contact@georank.site</email>

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.subtitle: What cookies are, the types we use, and how you can control them.
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how GeoRank uses cookies and similar technologies on our website. By using the Service, you agree to the use of cookies as outlined in this policy.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site recognize your device and store information about your preferences or past actions.

sections.heading: Types of Cookies We Use
sections.content:
• Essential Cookies
    Necessary for the website to function properly. They enable core features such as authentication, security, network management, and accessibility. These cookies cannot be disabled.
  • Analytics Cookies
    Help us understand how visitors interact with the site. We use Umami, a privacy-focused analytics tool that does not use cookies for tracking and does not collect personally identifiable information.
  • Functionality Cookies
    Allow the website to remember choices you make (such as your preferred language, theme preferences, or dashboard layout) and provide enhanced features.

sections.heading: Third-Party Cookies
sections.content: We minimize the use of third-party cookies. Our analytics solution (Umami) is self-hosted and privacy-focused. We do not use advertising cookies or share cookie data with advertisers.

sections.heading: Managing Cookies
sections.content:
Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through settings. You can usually configure your browser to:

  • Accept or reject all cookies
  • Notify you when a cookie is set
  • Delete cookies manually or automatically

Please note that disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of the Service.

sections.heading: More Information
sections.content: For more details on how we handle personal data, please see our Privacy Policy.
